groups.activity: The New War, then Jade Shadows, then Jade Shadows: Constellations

rows.label: Jade Shadows: Constellations
rows.note: solo, not replayable; type FATHER to confirm

conditions: Constellations locks every other mission out for roughly 90 minutes.
Completing it awards the Sirius & Orion main blueprint and unlocks Uranus Proxima plus the Pontis Tower hub where Hunhow trades Talents.

groups.activity: Skirmish into Assassinate: The Kuva Wytch or Scoria's Angel
groups.meta: 14.29% each part, guaranteed one blueprint per clear
groups.mode: solo from Pontis Tower for your own Railjack
conditions: Squads always get a loaner Railjack (Santovan's Oath or Marrowbone); your own ship only offers as an option from Pontis Tower, and only when matchmaking is set to Solo before you enter.

The Kuva Wytch pays Emerald Talent and drops Pride parts alongside the frame; Scoria's Angel pays Crimson Talent and drops Wrath parts. Pick one node, since a part purchase spends only the matching Talent type.
bonuses: Each clear also guarantees one of four Uranus Proxima arcanes, plus 12-16 Talents (18-22 Steel Path).

Shooting the flight-section targets (the Orowyrm on Kuva Wytch, the Ramsled on Scoria's Angel) pays up to 4 more Talents (12 on Steel Path) plus Tellurium, Mk III Railjack parts, Endo and credits; it's personal loot, so don't AFK through it.

disclosures.title: run Steel Path once you can
disclosures.body: Steel Path pays roughly 50% more Talents per clear and the flight bonus goes from 4 to 12; both nodes run about 7 minutes solo on Steel Path.
